coverage_interpretation.mechanism_core: All current hard survivors lie in H2 evidence value × H3 shared-resource conflict × H4 coupled-sequential-commitment compositions.

diagnostic_contract.claim_boundary: This audit establishes failure structure inside the frozen Layer-1 simulator. It does not by itself prove field frequency or cross-domain universality.
diagnostic_contract.first_irreversible_loss: prefix exact-completable before the baseline action and exact-noncompletable after it
diagnostic_contract.frontier: all legal actions at the first-loss prefix are independently exact-checked; preserving alternatives are recorded
diagnostic_contract.future_query_allowance: len(obligations)+2 at every diagnostic continuation; query-count scarcity is therefore not sufficient to create a first-loss label
diagnostic_contract.representative_rule: one frozen V8 representative recipe per exact survivor signature

purpose: Explain the Layer-1 hard-survivor surface before any new method or learning work.
